description: This file is a shell script used for platform-specific upgrade procedures within the OpenWrt firmware management system. It defines functions for checking images and performing upgrades on the RT3883 platform, utilizing a case statement to determine the appropriate upgrade method based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the integrity or suitability of the firmware image for the platform.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the platform-specific upgrade, delegating to a default upgrade method.
